treaty_name: Agreement between the Republic of Singapore and the Kingdom of Morocco for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income (2007)
eif_quote: Date of Conclusion: 9 January 2007 Entry into Force: 15 January 2014 Effective Date: 1 January 2015 || Art. 28(2)(b)(i) [Morocco]: in respect of taxes withheld at source, for amount paid or credited, on or after the first day of January of the first calendar year following that in which this Agreement enters into force

rates.quote: (a) 8 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;

2. However, such dividends may also be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the dividends is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed: ... (b) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

2. However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

2. However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise, and according to the law of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.quote: The Agreement has no principal-purpose/main-purpose clause. Morocco has signed but not ratified the MLI, so the MLI does not modify this Agreement.

notes: Interest paid to the Government of the other State is exempt (Art. 11(3)-(4)): for Singapore this includes MAS, GIC and statutory bodies, and for Morocco the Central Bank. Not modelled. Branch profits tax is capped at 8% of after-tax PE profits (Art. 10(6)). Art. 10(7): Singapore currently charges no tax on dividends beyond the tax on company profits. 'Royalties' includes equipment rental and software. Effective dates: in Morocco, withholding taxes apply to amounts paid or credited from 2015-01-01. In Singapore, the Agreement applies from year of assessment 2016 (1 January of the second calendar year after entry into force). IRAS gives 1 January 2015 as the effective date, and 2015-01-01 is used for every tier.
unverified: Singapore-source payments: Art. 28(2)(a) points to YA 2016 onwards, so 2015-01-01 may be early for that direction.
